target.role: Consultant / Senior Consultant, Corporate Treasury Modeling and Advisory

summary: Consultant / Senior Consultant, Corporate Treasury Modeling and Advisory candidate with ~7 years across asset-liability management (ALM), balance-sheet risk, and model-governance work at Moody's Analytics, EY, and Ortec Finance. Develops and validates structural interest rate risk, liquidity stress-testing, and balance-sheet aggregation models; holds delegated sign-off authority on multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement). CFA charterholder with dual MSc degrees (Financial Modelling, Chemical Engineering).

sections.heading: Balance-Sheet Model Development and Validation
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and asset-liability management (ALM) outputs delivered to institutional client portfolios of $5–25bn per engagement ($50bn+ cumulative); independently reviews curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.
Validates balance-sheet aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level ALM and capital adequacy metrics across client treasury and investment books.
Validates derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation; reviews sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level ALM aggregates to support structural risk reporting.

Operates within a formal model-governance framework — performs independent model validation: reviews model assumptions, assesses economic defensibility, escalates outputs lacking mathematical or analytical support; documentation standards aligned with SR 11-7-style validation practices.

sections.heading: Structural Interest Rate Risk & Liquidity Stress Testing
bullets: Oversees structural interest rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, consistent with industry IRRBB frameworks applicable to bank treasury balance sheets.
Embeds behavioural cash-flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays aligned with regulatory liquidity stress-testing and contingency-planning expectations.

Led the design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — delivering forward-looking liquidity visibility across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) to support funding optimisation and refinancing risk assessment.

sections.heading: Advisory, Tooling & Stakeholder Communication
bullets: Serves as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders; prepares analytical summaries on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities for senior decision-makers.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines; deployed agentic-AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor) reducing development cycle time by an estimated 30–40% on comparable modules.

Led onboarding and implementation of the PFaroe analytics platform for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms; advised on asset, liability, and ALM configurations and validated model outputs post-deployment.
Translated client investment-team requirements into Product Owner development requests; contributed to the successful migration of all assigned accounts from legacy Calypso to PFaroe.

roles.title: Senior Consultant – IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation engagements for Canadian and international insurance clients; advised actuarial, finance, IT, and PM functions on standard adoption and governance documentation.
Coordinated cross-functional milestone delivery across actuarial, risk, IT, and finance teams; contributed to go-to-market collateral for the IFRS 17 advisory service offering.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors; analysed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators to assess interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base and stressed environments.

Performed cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk; conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis on duration alignment and liquidity trade-offs.

Led the ALM study and onboarding for a three-plan university pension merger — on a team of three, developed and validated the model capturing funding-policy dynamics, duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.
Presented ALM findings on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) – Western University, 2016
